title: Product Type dropdown offers exactly three options with Parts & Service as the default
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report with no saved view (first visit or cleared browser storage).
steps: 1. Find the "Product Type" dropdown in the report toolbar.
2. Read its current value before touching it.
3. Open it and read the options in order.
expected: 1. A "Product Type" dropdown is visible in the report toolbar.
2. The default selection on first load is "Parts & Service."
3. It offers exactly three options, in this order: "Parts & Service," "Parts only," "Service only."
